meta.title: SceneNav AI — Autonomous Geospatial Localization Launch

scenes.purpose: Establish high tension: GNSS spoofing, satellite denial in electronic warfare, and the core vulnerability of autonomous aerospace systems.
scenes.emotionalBeat: Tension and urgency: satellites fail, optical sensors must adapt.
scenes.voiceover: In contested airspace, GPS is vulnerable to jamming and electronic spoofing. When satellites go dark, autonomous aerial systems need to see.
scenes.layout: Centered HUD tactical horizon, scanning reticles, threat status pills at top, dark micro-grid matrix backdrop.
scenes.elements: Tactical grid background, threat assessment badge [THREAT ASSESSMENT: GNSS-DENIED / EW JAMMED], pulse warning indicator, scanning crosshairs.
scenes.animation: Grid scales 1.05->1.0 over 10.8s; threat badge springs in with translateY(-20->0) and opacity 0->1; red-to-amber pulse on threat beacon.
scenes.lighting: Deep dark obsidian background with subtle radial cyan glow behind center focal point.
scenes.transitionOut: Compound directional wipe to the right with blur(0->6px) and scale(1.0->0.96).

scenes.purpose: Hero reveal of SceneNav AI: the autonomous visual localization workstation loading high-resolution georeferenced satellite base maps.
scenes.emotionalBeat: Clarity and technological superiority: mathematical certainty replaces GPS dependency.
scenes.voiceover: Introducing SceneNav AI: real-time visual localization and geospatial intelligence for autonomous navigation.
scenes.layout: Hero workstation interface view, top telemetry ribbon, side-by-side aerial reference and query inspection viewports.
scenes.elements: Header navigation bar, status beacon [RECON ONLINE], dataset selection card with Greenwood 0.15m GSD orthophoto.
scenes.animation: Hero workspace springs in from scale 0.94->1.0 with blur 8->0px; dataset card cascades from right with 150ms stagger; HUD corner brackets expand on hover.
scenes.lighting: Specular top rim highlight with 0.08 opacity gradient sweep across interface cards.
scenes.transitionOut: Scale dissolve into matching execution with expanding concentric pulse.

scenes.purpose: Demonstrate the real-time computer vision matching engine: invariant SIFT/ORB feature extraction and RANSAC filtering.
scenes.emotionalBeat: Kinetic power and computational speed: thousands of descriptors resolved in milliseconds.
scenes.voiceover: Ingesting raw reconnaissance feeds, our pipeline extracts invariant features and executes robust RANSAC geometric filtering.
scenes.layout: Dual image comparison canvas, concentric radar sweep rings, real-time keypoint correspondence overlay.
scenes.elements: Radar sweep emitter, glowing cyan correspondence vectors connecting query points to satellite reference, live telemetry counters.
scenes.animation: Dual radar sweep rotates 360 deg; keypoint lines spring in with radial burst stagger; match metrics counter ticks rapidly up to 224.
scenes.lighting: Electric cyan laser glow along correspondence vectors, dark vignette around perimeter.
scenes.transitionOut: Zoom through center into Lightbox modal inspection.

scenes.purpose: Inspect the 224 verified geometric inliers and sub-pixel ground footprint re-projection onto the satellite orthophoto.
scenes.emotionalBeat: Awe and precision: verifiable mathematical proof of ground coordinates.
scenes.voiceover: Over two hundred geometric inliers lock the sensor footprint directly onto georeferenced satellite imagery with sub-pixel precision.
scenes.layout: High-magnification Lightbox modal, panning across keypoint clusters, followed by satellite footprint bounding polygon view.
scenes.elements: Lightbox inspection overlay, zoom pan controls, emerald green bounding polygon with WGS-84 UTM Zone 32N coordinates.
scenes.animation: Lightbox scales up with spring(damping: 18, stiffness: 220); crosshair sweeps across inliers; footprint polygon draws with strokeDashoffset animation.
scenes.camera: Slow macro pan across inlier cluster, pulling back to full orthophoto view.
scenes.lighting: Emerald green specular glow (#10b981) highlighting the accepted ground footprint boundary.
scenes.transitionOut: Horizontal slide transition with momentum transfer to cadastral viewer.

scenes.purpose: Demonstrate multi-temporal cadastral analysis and robustness against extreme seasonal, illumination, and urban morphology changes.
scenes.emotionalBeat: Resilience: proof that the system works across seasons, decades, and environmental shifts.
scenes.voiceover: Inspect multi-temporal cadastral changes, test extreme illumination shifts, and evaluate spatial drift in real time.
scenes.layout: Munich Cadastral split comparison viewer, interactive dual-layer opacity slider wiping between historical and modern orthophotos.
scenes.elements: Dual-layer comparison canvas, opacity slider thumb with glowing white reticle, cadastral parcel boundary overlays.
scenes.animation: Opacity slider moves smoothly left-to-right (0% -> 100% -> 50%) revealing historical vs modern aerial layers; cadastral boundaries pulse.
scenes.camera: Steady centered framing focusing on the slider wipe motion.
scenes.lighting: High-contrast split lighting emphasizing seasonal change across terrain.
scenes.transitionOut: Subtle blur dissolve (blur 0->8px) into the diagnostic telemetry matrix.

scenes.purpose: Deliver the final climactic proof: Hartley-Zisserman validation report, 0.42m repeatability delta, and bold closing brand identity.
scenes.emotionalBeat: Triumph, confidence, and ultimate authority: mission accomplished.
scenes.voiceover: SceneNav AI. Visual Intelligence. Spatial Understanding. Even when the satellites fail.
scenes.layout: Diagnostic matrix panel transitioning to bold centered cinematic logo reveal with live beacon and DRDO aerospace accreditation.
scenes.elements: Reliability KPI score [98.4% ACCEPTED], 0.42m repeatability badge, SceneNav AI brand typography, tactical tagline, DRDO reconnaissance lock.
scenes.animation: Reliability score springs into center with text slam; brand typography resolves with light sweep sheen; final fade to obsidian black.
scenes.camera: Slow cinematic pull-out (scale 1.05 -> 1.0) holding on final logo.
scenes.lighting: Cinematic volumetric cyan light beam sweeping behind the SceneNav AI logo; soft vignette.
